description: Headset A/B scenario, run with --env LB_MAX_FPS=120 so frame time shows the game's cost instead of the 60 fps cap (the build installed before 2026-11-10 logs no work column). coc whiterunorigin, stand (idle), run up the street (run). Frame numbers assume up to 120 fps: menu by 1800, city loaded by 6000. At frame 3100 the console is reopened for `bat benchwx` (benchwx.txt: fw then sw 0000081A, SkyrimClear), so every run has the same clear sky, as in the Mac scenarios: the region's weather is otherwise picked at random per run, and overcast runs draw about 57 more effect draws per frame (measured in Riverwood on the M5). On the headset the coc load's long frames end by frame 2030 (2026-11-10 runs), and the batch is typed, run and closed by frame 3218, well before the first measured phase. LB_VPAD=0 so the A in `bat` is typed rather than pressed as stick-left (see boss-fight-mac); the scripted keys here are keyboard keys, which work without the virtual pad.
